headlines.title: 5 Best AI Stocks to Buy After Wells Fargo’s Outlook Upgrade
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo is no longer telling investors to stay away from the AI infrastructure trade. In a new note, analysts led by Ohsung Kwon raised the firm’s view on US AI infrastructure to neutral from negative. The change follows a deep selloff.

headlines.title: AI Debt Binge Hits a Wall As Global Bond Markets Reach Saturation Point, Wells Fargo Warns
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo warns that massive corporate borrowing to fund AI infrastructure is straining the $15 trillion investment-grade bond market, and investors are pushing back.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Up 6.1% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo (WFC) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo whistleblower argues SEC played ‘fast and loose’
headlines.summary: Michael Bacon, a former Wells Fargo executive-turned-whistleblower, is appealing a decision by the Securities and Exchange Commission to slash the size of his award. His lawyer argues the agency had political motives.

headlines.title: Wells Fargo keeps CoreWeave at Overweight, $115 target after funding update
headlines.summary: CoreWeave's plan to raise under $5 billion of parent-level capital through 2027 and skip unsecured debt at current yields was the bigger positive than the quarter's beat, Wells Fargo said.

description: Wells Fargo & Company, a financial services company, provides diversified banking, investment, mortgage, and consumer and commercial finance products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking and Lending; Commercial Banking; Corporate and Investment Banking; and Wealth and Investment Management. The company's financial products and services includes checking and savings accounts, and credit and debit cards, as well as home, auto, personal, and small business lending services. It also provides personalized wealth management, brokerage, financial planning, lending, private banking, trust and fiduciary products and services; and financial solutions to private, family owned and public companies through products and services including banking and credit products across multiple industry sectors and municipalities, secured lending and lease products, and treasury management. In addition, it offers a suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services, such as corporate banking, investment banking, treasury management, commercial real estate lending and servicing, equity, and fixed income solutions, as well as sales, trading, and research capabilities services to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients. Wells Fargo & Company was founded in 1852 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
